topics.title: Logarifm — Asosiy tushunchalar va xossalari
topics.content:
LOGARIFM — KIRISH VA ASOSIY XOSSALAR

Logarifm — bu daraja ko'rsatkichini topish amali. a^x = b tenglamasida x ni topish:
log_a(b) = x  ←→  a^x = b

Shartlar: a > 0, a ≠ 1, b > 0

Misollar:
- log_2(8) = 3, chunki 2³ = 8
- log_3(81) = 4, chunki 3⁴ = 81
- log_5(1/25) = -2, chunki 5⁻² = 1/25

ASOSIY 10 TA XOSSA (a > 0, a ≠ 1, b > 0, b ≠ 1):

1. a^(log_a(x)) = x
   Logarifm va daraja bir-birini bekor qiladi.
   Misol: 2^(log_2(5)) = 5, 10^(lg(7)) = 7

2. log_a(a) = 1  va  log_a(1) = 0
   Misol: log_5(5) = 1, log_100(1) = 0

3. log_a(x·y) = log_a(x) + log_a(y),  x,y > 0
   Ko'paytmaning logarifmi = logarifmlar yig'indisi.
   Misol: log_2(4·8) = log_2(4) + log_2(8) = 2 + 3 = 5
   XATO: log_a(x+y) ≠ log_a(x) + log_a(y)

4. log_a(x/y) = log_a(x) - log_a(y),  x,y > 0
   Bo'linmaning logarifmi = logarifmlar ayirmasi.
   Misol: log_3(27/9) = log_3(27) - log_3(9) = 3 - 2 = 1
   XATO: log_a(x/y) ≠ log_a(x) / log_a(y)

5. log_a(x^p) = p · log_a(x),  x > 0
   Daraja ko'rsatkichi oldiga chiqadi.
   Misol: log_3(√3) = log_3(3^(1/2)) = 1/2

6. log_a(x) = log_b(x) / log_b(a)  — O'TISH FORMULASI
   Logarifm asosini ixtiyoriy songa o'zgartirish mumkin.
   Misol: log_2(8) = lg(8)/lg(2) = 3

7. log_a(b) · log_b(a) = 1
   Asosni almashtirish: ko'paytma doim 1 ga teng.
   Misol: log_2(3) · log_3(2) = 1
   Demak: log_b(a) = 1 / log_a(b)

8. log_a(b) = log_(a^p)(b^p),  p ≠ 0
   Asos va argumentni bir xil darajaga ko'tarish mumkin.
   Misol: log_2(3) = log_4(9) = log_8(27)

9. a^(log_b(c)) = c^(log_b(a))
   Misol: 2^(log_3(5)) = 5^(log_3(2))

10. a^(√(log_a(b))) = b^(√(log_b(a)))

LOGARIFMIK FUNKSIYANING ANIQLANISH SOHASI:
log_a(f(x)) uchun shart: f(x) > 0
log_(g(x))(f(x)) uchun 3 ta shart bir vaqtda:
  (1) f(x) > 0
  (2) g(x) > 0
  (3) g(x) ≠ 1

Misol: y = log_(x²)(4-x) aniqlanish sohasini topish.
  4-x > 0 → x < 4
  x² > 0  → x ≠ 0
  x² ≠ 1  → x ≠ ±1
Javob: (-∞;-1) ∪ (-1;0) ∪ (0;1) ∪ (1;4)

TEZ-TEZ UCHRAYDIGAN XATOLAR:
  ✗ log(a+b) = log(a)+log(b)  →  ✓ log(a·b) = log(a)+log(b)
  ✗ log(a/b) = log(a)/log(b)  →  ✓ log(a/b) = log(a)-log(b)
  ✗ log_a(x) x=0 da aniqlanadi →  ✓ faqat x>0 da aniqlanadi

topics.title: Logarifm — Tenglamalar va Tengsizliklar
topics.content:
LOGARIFM — TENGLAMALAR, TENGSIZLIKLAR VA GRAFIK

LOGARIFMIK TENGLAMALAR:

Asosiy tur 1: log_a(f(x)) = log_a(g(x))  →  f(x) = g(x)
(f(x) > 0 va g(x) > 0 ekanini tekshirish shart!)

Asosiy tur 2: log_a(f(x)) = b  →  f(x) = a^b

Misol: log_2(x-3) = 3
  x - 3 = 2³ = 8  →  x = 11
  Tekshiruv: 11-3 = 8 > 0 ✓

Misol: lg(x-3) - lg(x+9) = lg(x-2)
  lg((x-3)/(x+9)) = lg(x-2)
  (x-3)/(x+9) = x-2
  x-3 = (x-2)(x+9) = x²+7x-18
  x²+6x-15 = 0

LOGARIFMIK TENGSIZLIKLAR:
log_a(f(x)) > log_a(g(x)) bo'lganda:
  - a > 1 bo'lsa:     f(x) > g(x)  (ishora O'ZGARMAYDI)
  - 0 < a < 1 bo'lsa: f(x) < g(x)  (ishora O'ZGARADI!)

LOGARIFMIK FUNKSIYA GRAFIGI y = log_a(x):
  - a > 1 bo'lsa: o'suvchi funksiya, I va IV chorak
  - 0 < a < 1 bo'lsa: kamayuvchi funksiya, II va III chorak
  - Har doim (1; 0) nuqtadan o'tadi
  - y = -log_5(x): grafigi x o'qi bo'yicha simmetrik → III va IV chorak

JUFT VA TOQ FUNKSIYALAR:
  Juft: f(-x) = f(x)  →  grafik y o'qi bo'yicha simmetrik
  Toq: f(-x) = -f(x) →  grafik koordinatalar boshi bo'yicha simmetrik

Misollar:
  y₁ = 3^x + 3^(-x)              → JUFT (chunki 3^(-x)+3^x = 3^x+3^(-x))
  y₃ = √(20-x+x²) + √(20+x+x²) → JUFT
  y₅ = x² + lg|x|                → JUFT
  y₂ = 3x⁵ + x³                  → TOQ

SONLARNI TAQQOSLASH (log_a(b) ning ishorasi):
  a > 1,    b > 1   → log_a(b) > 0
  a > 1,    0<b<1   → log_a(b) < 0
  0<a<1,   b > 1   → log_a(b) < 0
  0<a<1,   0<b<1   → log_a(b) > 0

TAQQOSLASH QOIDASI:
  a > 1 bo'lsa: m > n  ←→  log_a(m) > log_a(n)
  0<a<1 bo'lsa: m > n  ←→  log_a(m) < log_a(n)

topics.title: Logarifm — Hisoblash va Soddalashtirish
topics.content:
LOGARIFM — HISOBLASH VA SODDALASHTIRISH

ASOSIY HISOBLASH USULLARI:

1. DARAJAGA KELTIRISH:
   log_a(a^n) = n
   log_(a^n)(a) = 1/n
   Misol: log_2(32) = log_2(2⁵) = 5
   Misol: log_4(2) = log_(2²)(2) = 1/2

2. O'TISH FORMULASI:
   log_a(b) = log_c(b) / log_c(a) = 1 / log_b(a)
   Misol: log_6(45) = log_3(45)/log_3(6) = (2+a)/(1+b)
   [agar log_3(5)=a, log_3(2)=b bo'lsa]

3. ZANJIR FORMULASI:
   log_a(b) · log_b(c) = log_a(c)
   log_a(b) · log_b(c) · log_c(d) = log_a(d)
   Misol: log_3(4)·log_4(5)·log_5(9) = log_3(9) = 2

4. DARAJALI IFODALAR (muhim!):
   a^(log_a(b)) = b
   10^(lg(x)) = x
   e^(ln(x)) = x
   a^(lg b) = b^(lg a)  ← bu xossa juda ko'p ishlatiladi!

MURAKKAB IFODALARNI SODDALASHTIRISH:

O'rinbosar usuli (t qo'yish):
  5^x + 5^(-x) = 13  →  t = 5^x qo'yamiz
  t + 1/t = 13  →  t² - 13t + 1 = 0
  (5^x - 5^(-x))² = (5^x + 5^(-x))² - 4 = 169 - 4 = 165

Geometrik qator bilan:
  1 + 1/2 + 1/4 + ...    = 1/(1-1/2) = 2    [|q|<1 bo'lsa: S = a₁/(1-q)]
  1 - 1/2 + 1/4 - ...    = 1/(1+1/2) = 2/3
  4(1 + 1/2 + 1/4 + ...) = 4·2 = 8

Mashhur hisoblash misollar:
  log_3(12) - log_3(4) = log_3(3) = 1
  2·log_5(10) - log_5(4) = log_5(100/4) = log_5(25) = 2
  log_2(3)·log_3(4)·log_4(8) = log_2(8) = 3

AMALIY QIYMATLAR (yodlash foydali):
  lg(2) ≈ 0.301     ln(2) ≈ 0.693
  lg(3) ≈ 0.477     π ≈ 3.14159
  lg(5) = 1 - lg(2) ≈ 0.699
  lg(6) = lg(2) + lg(3) ≈ 0.778
  lg(7) ≈ 0.845

LOGARIFM VA ILDIZ:
  log_(√a)(b) = 2·log_a(b)
  log_a(√b) = (1/2)·log_a(b)
  log_(∛a)(b) = 3·log_a(b)

questions.question_text: (96-6-52) y = log_3(2-x) funksiyaning aniqlanish sohasini toping.
questions.explanation: log_3(2-x) aniqlanishi uchun 2-x > 0, ya'ni x < 2. Javob: (-∞; 2)

questions.question_text: (97-1-63) y = log_x(3-x) funksiyaning aniqlanish sohasini toping.
questions.explanation: Shartlar: 3-x > 0 → x < 3; asos x > 0 va x ≠ 1. Kesishma: (0;1) ∪ (1;3)

questions.question_text: (97-6-64) f(x) = log_x(6-x) funksiyaning aniqlanish sohasini toping.
(97-8-52) y = log_(x-1)(x - 1/4) funksiyaning aniqlanish sohasini toping.
(97-9-75) n ning qanday butun qiymatlarida y = lg(nx^2 - 5x + 1) funksiyaning aniqlanish sohasi (-∞; 1/4] ∪ [1; ∞) bo'ladi?
questions.explanation: nx^2 - 5x + 1 > 0 ning aniqlanish sohasi berilgan to'plam bo'lishi uchun diskriminant D = 25 - 4n = 0 bo'lishi kerak, ya'ni n = 25/4 emas. n=4 da D=25-16=9, ildizlar x=1/4 va x=1. Javob: 4

questions.question_text: (99-2-36) f(x) = sqrt(8-x) / lg(x-1) funksiyaning aniqlanish sohasiga nechta butun qiymat tegishli?
questions.explanation: Shartlar: 8-x ≥ 0 → x ≤ 8; lg(x-1) mavjud va ≠ 0 uchun x-1 > 0, x-1 ≠ 1 → x > 1, x ≠ 2. Butun sonlar: 3,4,5,6,7,8 — 6 ta.

questions.question_text: (99-3-26) y = 1/ln(1-x) + sqrt(x+2) funksiyaning aniqlanish sohasini toping.
(99-5-39) f(x) = log_2(64^(-x) - 8^(1-x)) funksiyaning aniqlanish sohasini toping.
(99-6-29) y = log_3(x(x-3)) - log_3(x) funksiyaning aniqlanish sohasini toping.
questions.explanation: Shartlar: x(x-3) > 0 va x > 0. x > 0 da x(x-3) > 0 bo'lishi uchun x > 3. Javob: (3; ∞)

questions.question_text: (98-5-15) Quyidagilardan qaysilari juft funksiya? y1=3^x+3^(-x), y2=3x^5+x^3, y3=sqrt(20-x+x^2)+sqrt(20+x+x^2), y4=log_3(4x+1), y5=x^2+lg|x|
questions.explanation: Juft funksiya: f(-x)=f(x). y1: 3^(-x)+3^x = y1 ✓. y3: sqrt(20+x+x^2)+sqrt(20-x+x^2) = y3 ✓. y5: (-x)^2+lg|-x| = x^2+lg|x| = y5 ✓. Javob: y1, y3, y5
log_3(18) = log_3(2·9) = log_3(2) + 2. t = log_3(2) qo'yib: (2t^2 - t(t+2))/(2t+t+2) = (t^2-2t)/(3t+2) = t(t-2)/(3t+2). t=log_3(2) qiymatida hisoblash: javob 1/2.
Surat: 3log_8(15) + log_8(3). Maxraj: log_8(15) + log_8(3) = log_8(45). Surat = log_8(15^3 · 3) = log_8(45^3/3^2·3) ... soddalashtirib: 3·log_8(45)/log_8(45) = 3. Javob: 3
lg8·log_2(10) + log_9·log_3(5) ifodasi soddalashtiriladi. log_2(10) = log_2(2·5) = 1+log_2(5). Zanjir formulasidan foydalanib javob: 3
